name: Modio Health OneView
description: Modio Health OneView is a comprehensive credentialing and provider enrollment platform that automates the entire credentialing lifecycle. The platform combines provider data management, primary source verification, payer enrollment, and ongoing monitoring into a single solution, helping healthcare organizations reduce credentialing time by up to 80% while maintaining compliance with NCQA and CMS requirements.

pricing.notes: Pricing varies based on provider count, modules selected, and contract length. Volume discounts available for 50+ providers. Implementation fees typically range from $5,000-25,000 depending on scope.

faqs.question: How much does Modio Health OneView cost?
faqs.answer: Modio Health OneView pricing typically ranges from $100-350 per provider per month depending on the modules selected. Basic credentialing starts around $100-200/provider, while full credentialing plus payer enrollment runs $200-350/provider. Enterprise pricing with custom integrations requires a quote. Implementation fees range from $5,000-25,000.

faqs.question: How long does credentialing take with Modio Health?
faqs.answer: Modio Health OneView typically completes initial credentialing in 14-30 days, compared to the industry average of 90-120 days. Primary source verification is completed within 24-72 hours. Re-credentialing takes 5-10 days. Payer enrollment timelines vary by payer but typically range from 30-90 days.

faqs.question: Is Modio Health NCQA accredited?
faqs.answer: Yes, Modio Health maintains NCQA CVO (Credentials Verification Organization) accreditation. This means their primary source verification processes meet the highest industry standards and are accepted by most health plans and healthcare organizations for delegated credentialing.

faqs.question: Does Modio Health integrate with CAQH ProView?
faqs.answer: Yes, Modio Health OneView has bi-directional integration with CAQH ProView. This allows organizations to pull provider data from CAQH, keep profiles synchronized, and reduce duplicate data entry. The integration helps streamline both initial credentialing and ongoing re-attestation workflows.
